data.long_meaning: Asini means 'fearless' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asana' which means 'seat' or 'position'. Asini was the name of a queen in Hindu mythology who was known for her fearlessness and courage. The name Asin carries the meaning “Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asin usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Asin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
